scope: Common W2.1 sessions and real local UDP only; not full W2/M1/M2 or system acceptance

verification.command: python -m compileall -q icd_runtime icd_gateway input_simulator scripts/test_icd_runtime.py

actual_network_cases: Real AF_INET UDP on explicitly granted loopback endpoints
Actual 36100 receiver/feedback source, 36102 source TX and 36101 feedback RX roles
Independent gateway and source subprocess SessionOpen exchange and process cleanup
Fragmented RunConfigure returns RECEIVED then FAILED/TARGET_MISSING
Original real feedback replay, forward/reverse ACL and request correlation
Bad CRC/oversize/foreign peer rejected before allocation
Reliable request sends at most four identical attempts; periodic control is not retried
Idle service expiry revokes session and releases reassembly
Feedback sequence reuse with different content rejected

review.mode: Read-only independent review plus focused rerun
review.important_finding: Different authorized grants could collide in pre-session fragmented SessionOpen reassembly
review.resolution: Local grant namespace restricted to SessionOpen/session0; shared 64-slot/channel and 8MiB budgets preserved
verified_regressions: Two interleaved valid Unicode fragmented opens both establish distinct sessions
Namespaces share channel capacity and cannot partition established business messages
Feedback same sequence/different content cannot satisfy another request
Source tracking capacity raises BUFFER_FULL instead of hiding it as network timeout
Duplicate complete grant identity refused; close clears state and refuses later receive
